protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: before the fix, hs_client_receive_rendezvous_acked accepted RENDEZVOUS_ESTABLISHED from a circuit whose purpose was merely C_ESTABLISH_REND and immediately changed it to C_REND_READY. hs_ident_circuit_new zero-initialized the rendezvous cookie and client keypair, while hs_circ_send_establish_rendezvous initialized them only when sending. The open-circuit path could return before sending or invoke circuit_has_opened again on an already-open cannibalized circuit, so a rendezvous point could race an unsolicited acknowledgement and advance the client with uninitialized handshake material.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 89eb96c19a091b1e892e4a7c05f06e188131aed0 is the smallest first-write commit for the surviving vulnerable v3 receive sink. It adds hs_client_receive_rendezvous_acked, performs only the purpose check, advances to C_REND_READY, and redirects RENDEZVOUS_ESTABLISHED dispatch to that handler. Blame at the direct-fix parent attributes every relevant pre-fix handler line to this commit.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: the immediate parent is b91693f7c3099c691d0e5dbb60ac55df14b7bd68, and its src/or/hs_client.c contains no hs_client_receive_rendezvous_acked function. The parent adds the send path but still dispatches acknowledgements to the legacy handler.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED: 89eb96c19a091b1e892e4a7c05f06e188131aed0 has exactly one parent and is a distinct prop224 series member immediately after the send-path commit; it is not a merge or squash aggregate, so no finer public member decomposition is required.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: CONFIRMED: the BIC is an ancestor of tor-0.3.5.3-alpha and tor-0.4.9.10. It is also already present in tor-0.3.2.1-alpha, which does not contradict the authoritative CVE affected boundary beginning at 0.3.5.3-alpha.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: direct fix 4efa20ae2615511dc2352844b4f3421b794c5c36 is not an ancestor of tor-0.4.9.10 and is an ancestor of tor-0.4.9.11. The tor-0.4.9.11 ChangeLog names bug 41297 and the rendezvous-point impersonation race.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED: single-parent commit 4efa20ae2615511dc2352844b4f3421b794c5c36 is the direct fix. It records sent_establish_rendezvous after a successful send, suppresses a second send, rejects RENDEZVOUS_ESTABLISHED when no send was recorded, and blocks INTRODUCE1 with a zero rendezvous cookie.
